description.nature: A support agent's credentials were phished; the attacker used the session to view customer profiles and change registered email addresses.
description.extent: 1,180 customer profiles viewed; registered email changed on 260 accounts.
description.location: Customer support console (fictional Zephyrine Travel Desk).
description.likelyImpact: Exposure of profile and booking details; account takeover of 260 accounts until restored.
description.consequencesForPrincipals: Unrequested booking changes and possible further phishing using booking details.
description.eventsCircumstancesReasons: Agent entered credentials on a fake sign-in page; the support console did not require a second factor.

findingsOnResponsiblePerson.summary: External attacker using phished staff credentials; not identified.

implemented: Original emails restored and affected accounts locked
proposed: Second factor for the support console
safetyMeasuresForPrincipals: Reset your password using the link in your account, not in an email
Check recent bookings for changes you did not make
